reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code, which is a nice touch, but I already take a magnesium from a brand I trust, and a new brand with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal isn't going to replace it.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A lab report the brand picked itself isn't the same as a third-party certification I already know. I'm not swapping a magnesium that works for an unknown.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box, plus a few hundred verified reviews.
